description:
The story revolves around D, the infamous "dunpeal" (born of a vampire father and a human mother) outcast and renowned vampire hunter. His prowess at hunting the creatures of the night allowing his acceptance among humans, he is called upon to locate Charlotte Elbourne, the lovely daughter of an affluent family who has been mysteriously kidnapped.

When the sun sets, the hunt goes on! Charlotte`s father offers a rich bounty, be she dead or alive, a task D willingly accepts, even with notorious Markus brothers and their gang of bounty hunters seeking the prize as well. Amidst the chase and unknown to all lurks a sinister evil which has been secretly manipulating their every move and has set a chilling trap that none will expect and few will survive. With the tables turned and the secrets revealed, the hunters could quickly become the hunted!

(Source: AniDB)

node.description:
D is a dhampir, the half-breed child of a vampire father the legendary Vampire lord and human mother, therefore he makes the ideal vampire hunter. He is renowned for his consummate skill and unearthly grace, but feared and despised for his mixed lineage: born of both races but belonging to neither. Often underestimated by his opponents, D has surprising power and resourcefulness, possessing most of the strengths and only mild levels of vampiric weaknesses. Unlike most dhampirs, D is able to live as a "normal" human, though marked by his unearthly beauty and powerful aura, and thus rarely accepted by humans.

His only notable weaknesses are that he is, while not unfeeling, emotionally remote but sometimes sentimental. He is also (far more rarely than other dhampirs) randomly susceptible to sun-sickness, a severe type of sunstroke, about once every five years. Otherwise, D does not suffer from vampiric weaknesses usual to dhampirs, possessing an imposing supernatural aura to his opponents and godlike reflexes surpassing even vampires.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Meier Link is an extremely powerful "vampire knight" who is being hunted by both D and the Marcus Brothers for kidnapping Charlotte.    Meier has the ability to change his long cape into steel with razor sharp edges, and his skill in using it matches D's skill with the sword.

Conspicuous as the sole woman of the group [The Marcus Brothers], although she isn't related by blood to the Marcus Brothers, they consider her their little sister. She fights using a very powerful gun. Leila joined the Marcus Brothers to avenge her parents, as her father was killed trying to rescue her mother from vampires, who in turn, turned her into a vampire too. The town's people stoned Leila's mother to death while a young Leila watched, helpless (Wiki).

D's constant companion is his talking left hand, sometimes reffered to as the Countenanced Carbuncle. It is revealed that this is some sort of symbiotic entity which has taken up residence in D's hand, although why he has done so is not clear. The hand (or 'Lefty' as fans have affectionately termed him) appears to have supernatural powers independent from his host, and occasionally uses them to help D. More often than not, however, Lefty generally prefers sitting back and letting D do the work, usually throwing in a sarcastic comment or two at D's expense.   (Source: Vampire Hunter D wikia)

name.native: シャーロット・エルバーン

node.description: Charlotte Elbourne was the girl that was thought to be kidnapped by Meier. Later it is revealed that she and Meier were actually in love and were running away to be together.    Charlotte wanted Meier to turn her into a vampire, but Meier refused to do so. They planned to use Carmilla's spaceship to escape into space.    (source: Absolute Anime)

Grove: The fourth brother, he is bed-ridden and is capable of astrally projecting his soul and dealing massive psychic attacks after receiving a special injection. In the movie, Grove is very close to Leila.  Source: Wikipedia

An ancient vampire who resides in the Castle of Chaythe, where Meier and Charlotte go in hopes that a still-functional ship can take them away from Earth. Many years earlier, Carmilla's blood lust had become so rampant that D's father, the Lord of Vampires, impaled her in her sleep, leaving her body to rot and her spirit imprisoned within her haunted castle.      ~!Carmilla turns out to be the true villain of the film: her invitation to Meier and Charlotte is a ruse, and her true intention is to sacrifice Charlotte and steal her body. Her plan is foiled, and she is killed once and for all by D with aid from Link. !~

The eldest of the Marcus Brothers and apparent leader, Borgoff carries a powerful wrist-mounted crossbow. Borgoff is incredibly skilled at using the crossbow, to such an extent that he can manually reload and fire the crossbow so rapidly that he can create a literal rain of silver bolts.    Borgoff and his brothers were hired to chase Meier Link, who had kidnapped Charlotte. Of all the brothers, Borgoff was the only one who thought it beneficial to work with D in capturing Merier Link rather than against him.

A shroud-encased mutant with a warped sense of humor and a kabuki-like white face and hands.     He crafts illusions and ensnares D with a dramatic time-space warping trap. He can expand and flatten himself into a shadow-like darkness, he can move along inside shadows and can actually kill a being by attacking their shadows.

Nolt Marcus is the tallest of the Marcus brother's, and has a white cross painted on his face with tubes going into the back of his head. His weapon is a large wooden hammer/stack. He will do anything for his brothers and hates the Barbaroi and the old guy.   ~!When the Markcus Brothers think they found Meier Link's carriage, Nolt was supposed to go and see if anyone was inside. After realizing nobody was there but a piece of cloth, he was killed by Benge and his shadow tricks.!~ (Source: Absolute Anime)

A tall, curvaceous female demon covered in a brilliant layer of green fur (with gold streaks) over parts of her body that converges into a wild mane of similar hair.     She can assume the molecular structure of other materials, such as wood or metal, and then manipulate them- such as to cause spikes to jut out from the surface.

With long hair and Arabian-esque clothing, Mashira is a mutant werewolf. He can transform into his wolf form at will. He has very keen senses and hears sounds over great distances.     He is probably the most loyal of the three- and is often the first to communicate with Meier.

A much feared and little seen tribe of monsters and mutants. While all of them identify themselves as Barbarois- they are in fact a large confederation made up a wide range of creatures.     Their skills and reputation allows them to be hired at high prices and they also appear to have a long history of serving vampires. While some consider their work only jobs, other display fierce loyalty to their client. Carmilla hires three very powerful Barbarois to guard Meier Link's carriage.

Kyle Markus is a team member in a group of professional vampire hunters widely known as "The Marcus Brothers". The four Marcus brothers are all related except Leila, however they still treat her like a younger sister.    Kyle has a very aloof personality and is quite confident in himself. He get excited easily when a bounty is spotted and enjoys attacking with his cross-shaped blades made of silver which he carries everywhere.    He has been known to flirt with Leila, but just for a tease.    (source: Absolute Anime)

Charlotte's brother. Before having negotiations with D tried to save his sister himself, however, was wounded and lost nearly all his people. Also, he was the one who hired Marcus brothers in order to save Charlotte.

"The Father" was an unidentified elder in Vishnu. He hired the Marcus Clan and Hunter D to rescue his daughter from Baron Mayerling. [Wikia]  He is ready to pay $10 mln. (considered to be a very big sum) in order to save his daughter. However, allows D to kill Charlotte is she has already been 'baptized' by the Noble. When D demands twice as much for that ($20 mln. is an enormous sum) agrees to pay the money.
